title: SEC0: Peer/deliver group chat does not verify sender is in participants list
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs DeliverHandler lines 219-248: for group chats (msg.participants non-empty), the code ensures the owner is in all_participants but does NOT verify that identity.user_id (the verified sender) is also in all_participants. A malicious peer can send Peer/deliver with participants=["uid-bob","uid-carol"] (omitting themselves); the resulting chat row has members [uid-bob, uid-carol, owner] but a message with sender_user_id=uid-sender who is not a chat member. The chatId hash is also computed over a list that excludes the sender, so it won't match the sender's own chatId computation. Fix: after building all_participants, assert identity.user_id is present and return invalidArguments if not.
